panels.description: Displays the rate at which items are being indexed, calculated as the per-second average over the last 5 minutes. Useful for monitoring real-time indexing performance and identifying potential bottlenecks during batch processing.
panels.title: Indexing Rate

panels.description: Displays the rate at which items are being indexed per category, calculated as the per-second average over the last 5 minutes. Useful for monitoring real-time indexing performance and identifying potential bottlenecks during batch processing.

panels.description: Shows the percentage of JVM heap memory used by indexingservice-v1 in the selected namespace. This metric helps monitor memory pressure and potential GC issues by comparing jvm_memory_bytes_used to jvm_memory_bytes_max.

targets.expr: (max by (instance)(jvm_memory_bytes_used{kubernetes_namespace="$namespace", kubernetes_name="indexingservice-v1", area="heap"}) / max by (instance)(jvm_memory_bytes_max{kubernetes_namespace="$namespace", kubernetes_name="indexingservice-v1", area="heap"})) * 100

panels.title: JVM Heap Usage (%)

panels.description: Shows the CPU usage percentage over the last 5 minutes for indexingservice-v1. This represents the average CPU consumption as a percentage of a single core.
